en.name: Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls
en.summary: A papal basilica built over the traditional burial site of the apostle Paul, largely rebuilt after a catastrophic 1823 fire.
en.body: Founded under Constantine over the tomb of St. Paul, the basilica was almost entirely destroyed by fire in 1823 and rebuilt in the following decades, preserving its ancient plan and a chain of papal portrait mosaics running the length of the nave.
